name: Pochampally Double Ikat
shortDescription: Pochampally double Ikat — warp and weft both dyed before weaving. Geometric patterns in teal and gold silk.
description: Pochampally Double Ikat is one of the most technically demanding weaves in the world — both the warp and weft threads are resist-dyed before weaving, requiring extraordinary precision for the pattern to align perfectly. This teal and gold silk Ikat features traditional geometric patterns with a striking contemporary feel.
weaveStory: Pochampally, a village near Hyderabad in Telangana, is the birthplace of Indian double Ikat silk. The Pochampally Ikat received GI protection in 2004 and is one of only a handful of double Ikat traditions in the world.
careInstructions: Dry clean only. The double Ikat technique makes this saree susceptible to thread damage if harshly washed. Store in muslin.
